title: A group action free on residue fields defines an etale equivalence relation
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a group homomorphism G -> Aut_S(U) such that every non-identity element fixing a point u acts nontrivially on the residue field kappa(u), the map j : R = coproduct_{g in G} U -> U x_S U, (g, x) -> (g(x), x) is an etale equivalence relation, so that F = U/R is an algebraic space by the presentation theorem (source lines 2463-2487). The proof shows j is a monomorphism by testing on a nonempty T and reducing a coincidence g o h = g' o h to the residue-field condition, then checks the relation and equivalence-relation axioms on T-valued points and observes that s and t are etale as coproducts of copies of U.
